Load necessary dependencies and mock dataset
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tma)
library(ona)
mock_data <- read_csv("./mock_data.csv") %>% # note: for purposes of testing, Mentor is in PAM not Mentor Group
  rename(indices = "...1") 
```

Initialize units, codes, HOO rules, and contexts
```{r}
unit_cols <- c("userID", "Condition")
codes <- c("A", "B", "C")

# Use modality column to specify HOO rules here
# note: Use HOO from TMA demo
HOO_rules_model <- tma:::rules(
  modality %in% "chat" & chatGroup %in% UNIT$chatGroup & Condition %in% UNIT$Condition, modality %in% "resource" & userID %in% UNIT$userID & Condition %in% UNIT$Condition
)

context_model <- tma:::contexts(
  x = mock_data,
  units = unit_cols,
  hoo_rules = HOO_rules_model
)
```

Ground truth connection counts computed manually on white board
```{r}
# 1.1 sending, unordered 
# User1: A & C is 4, everything else 0 (good)
# User2: A & B is 3, A & C is 1, B & C is 2 (good)
# User3: A & B is 2, A & C is 4, B & C is 2 (good)

# 1.2 sending, ordered
# User1: A & C is 4, everything else 0 (good)
# User2: A & B is 3, A & C is 1, B & C is 1, C & B is 1 (good)
# User3: A & C is 2, B & A is 2, B & C is 2, C & A is 2 (good)

# 2.1 receiving, unordered
# User1: A & C is 2, everything else 0 (good)
# User2: A & B is 1, A & C is 0.5, B & C is 1 (good)
# User3: A & B is 2, A & C is 2, B & C is 2 (good)

# 2.2 receiving, ordered 
# User1: A & C is 2, everything else 0 (good)
# User2: A & B is 1, A & C is 0.5, B & C is 0.5, C & B is 0.5 (good)
# User3: B & A is 2, B & C is 2, A & C is 1, C & A is 1 (good)
```

Connection counts computed by TMA function (sending): 1.1 unordered 1.2 ordered
```{r}
accum_unordered_sending<- tma:::accumulate_contexts (
    x = context_model,
    codes = codes,
    weight.by = function(x) { x },
    decay.function = function(x) {
        learner_effect <- c("Mentor" = 2, "Player" = 1)
        learner <- FULL_CONTEXT[ROWS, role]
        weight <- (x < (360)) * learner_effect[learner]
        return(weight)
    },
    time.column = "timeStamp",
    return.ena.set = TRUE,
    mode.column = "role"
)

accum_ordered_sending <- tma:::accumulate_contexts (
    x = context_model,
    codes = codes,
    weight.by = function(x) { x },
    decay.function = function(x) {
        learner_effect <- c("Mentor" = 2, "Player" = 1)
        learner <- FULL_CONTEXT[ROWS, role]
        weight <- (x < (360)) * learner_effect[learner]
        return(weight)
    },
    time.column = "timeStamp",
    return.ena.set = FALSE,
    mode.column = "role"
)

unordered_cc_gtruth_sending <- accum_unordered_sending$connection.counts
ordered_cc_gtruth_sending <- accum_ordered_sending$connection.counts

print(unordered_cc_gtruth_sending)
print(ordered_cc_gtruth_sending)
```
# User1: A & C is 4, everything else 0 (good)
# User2: A & B is 3, A & C is 1, B & C is 1, C & B is 1 (good)
# User3: A & C is 2, B & A is 2, B & C is 2, C & A is 2 (good)

```{r}
accum_unordered_receiving <- tma:::accumulate_contexts (
    x = context_model,
    codes = codes,
    weight.by = function(x) { x },
    decay.function = function(x) {
        learner_effect <- c("L1" = 1, "L2" = 0.5)
        learner <- FULL_CONTEXT[RESPONSE_INDEX, type]
        weight <- (x < 360) * learner_effect[learner]
        return(weight)
    },
    time.column = "timeStamp",
    return.ena.set = TRUE,
    mode.column = "type"
)

accum_ordered_receiving <- tma:::accumulate_contexts (
    x = context_model,
    codes = codes,
    weight.by = function(x) { x },
    decay.function = function(x) {
        learner_effect <- c("L1" = 1, "L2" = 0.5)
        learner <- FULL_CONTEXT[RESPONSE_INDEX, type]
        weight <- (x < (360)) * learner_effect[learner]
        return(weight)
    },
    time.column = "timeStamp",
    return.ena.set = FALSE,
    mode.column = "type"
)

unordered_cc_gtruth_receiving <- accum_unordered_receiving$connection.counts
ordered_cc_gtruth_receiving <- accum_ordered_receiving$connection.counts

print(unordered_cc_gtruth_receiving)
print(ordered_cc_gtruth_receiving)
```
